source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    fg = [v for v in counts if v != bg]
    if not fg:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mark = max(fg, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    color = 2 if mark == 0 else mark
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == mark]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if out[r0][c] == bg: out[r0][c] = color
        if out[r1][c] == bg: out[r1][c] = color
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if out[r][c0] == bg: out[r][c0] = color
        if out[r][c1] == bg: out[r][c1] = color
    return out
'''
